{{Top|leg}}
'''The Auction''' was the name given to a gathering of the underworld where [[Shipjacker/Legends|shipjackers]] sold their stolen [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Usually sponsored by a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] or [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] syndicate, it was a large event that spawned its own sub-cultures. In addition to the selling of stolen vessels, [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]] became floating [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], and private [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] provided accommodation. Alongside selling the ships, services selling components, upgrades and modifications were also in demand. [[Salvage ship]]s, [[smelting vessel]]s, and [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]] were common sights, including the services of those specializing in altering and masking [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]].<ref name="Ship Jackers">{{JournalCite|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
